messages.subject: Good Methodology Forum?
parts:
I have some methodological questions related to a SEM model I am running. This forum seems geared towards trouble shooting Lavaan problems, does anyone know a good methodology forum?

If the question is appropriate for this forum here it is:

I am running a model to see if changes in behavior due to a head injury relate to offending.

Three waves of data:
1 = pre injury
2 = post injury (looking for changes in behavior)
3 = offending

I have 4 latent variables assessed at W1 and W2, Predicting offending (manifest) at wave 3. I am looking if group membership (injury or no) moderates (restricting and freeing regression paths between groups) the relationship between the behaviors and offending.

My non injury group is large ~2700, while my injury group is small ~50. I think the size of group 2 is making my overall model unstable.

Is it justifiable to run 4 separate models (Each looking at a different latent behavior variable)?
